doc.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021

title: Recording Walk Tall with Bennie Maupin and Harvey Mason
summary: Walk Tall was his first record; Keepnews told him to get who he wanted and he chose Bennie Maupin and Harvey Mason. He discusses the solo-with-drums passage.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And there’s a point there, you know the band is like it’s so funky and then there’s a point where you’re soloing with only the drums.
And I love that because it’s like a different sound, a different texture, and then when the bass and etcetera come back in it’s like oh yeah.

Uh huh. Yeah. Well that was how I wanted it. That was pretty much it. And you know to this day I mean I enjoy that kind of playing, you know where I’m just soloing with one other person you know. And I still love to do that.
Why do you think your, I’m looking at your list from your website as a sideman, which runs close to one hundred and probably more than that now.

That’s right. I mean for this record I specifically, I mean because Orrin said, he said basically get who you want. And I wanted, at the time, Bennie Maupin, Harvey Mason, you know it was Herbie’s band you know. And so I got these guys and that was, you know, it was great. And “Walk Tall” that was that.
